product_metadata.title: MGP Bamboo Divider and Screen, 4 Panels, Self Standing, 72" W x 72" H, BSC-98
features: Use as a room divider or decoration.
Folds and stores easily when not in use.
Finished with outdoor sealant for extra protection.
description: This four panel self-standing bamboo screen room divider is handcrafted from natural Moso bamboo. It can be used in a home or business to separate an area for privacy or for creating an extra room. It folds to store easily when not in use. The bamboo screen panels are processed naturally for indoor and outdoor use. 72"W x 72"H
